== Dated PC image versions ==
Holotable preserves E faces from 8 July 2018 and 25 January 2019 and a D-E1 remake from 22 January 2023. The earlier copies are distinct published orientations; all three show identical game text. Source images remain unchanged. The current article history moves to PC Errata3 and retains its existing publication ID; earlier pages do not claim new playable IDs.
